event_records.description: The reorg is scheduled to begin today, but no changes have been implemented yet.

kestrel_analytics_support_team_members.name: Kestrel Analytics support team members
kestrel_analytics_support_team_members.persona_brief:
You are Kestrel Analytics support team members.
Each team member has their own perceptions about the upcoming reorg, but no one knows how it will actually affect their roles or workload. They have varying levels of trust in management and concerns about job security.

kestrel_analytics_management.name: Kestrel Analytics management
kestrel_analytics_management.persona_brief:
You are Kestrel Analytics management.
Management has decided on a reorganization of the support team, with the goal of improving efficiency. They have not yet communicated the details to the team.

resolution.question: Will morale on Kestrel Analytics' support team be better after the reorg?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if, by the hard cutoff, the persistent event history shows that a majority of support team members have expressed (in observable communications or surveys) that morale is better than before the reorg. Otherwise resolve NO.
